name: External Identity Provider Link Success
summary: An authenticated user explicitly links a validated, currently unlinked external provider subject to the current durable identity without creating or switching durable users.
finalOutcome: The selected external provider subject is associated with the current durable identity, and the same user remains authenticated.

sourceReferences.note: AssociateExternalLoginAsync requires the target user id to match the acting user before persisting an external login association.
Approved authentication policy requires independent NuvIoT email proof before an unlinked external provider may be linked to an existing durable identity; provider email is supporting evidence only.

External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
